answer_1.outputs: Scalar quality scores (1-5) and pairwise preference judgments (A/B) for generated responses

answer_2.quote: We use Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall-Tau as performance metrics to measure scoring correlations against reference evaluators. In pairwise ranking, we use accuracy as our metric to measure agreement between evaluator LMs and humans.

answer_3.quote: In this paradigm, LMs are either prompted to output a scalar indicator of quality (denoted as direct assessment) or to determine which of two outputs are preferred (denoted as pairwise ranking). The scoring decisions of PROMETHEUS 2 models, GPT-4-1106, Claude-3-Opus, and human evaluators all strongly correlate with each other.

answer_4.quote: FLASK (Ye et al., 2023) ... includes scores marked by human evaluators. HHH Alignment ... judged by human evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluated responses using score rubrics (1-5) for criteria such as helpfulness, harmlessness, honesty, and 1,000 custom evaluation criteria.
